frontdoor.positive_prefilter_only: A trusted positive prefilter removes a duplicate tree walk but cannot admit a Logs archive by itself.

final_admission.inverse_edge_count_source: V3/V2 final allowed-codec edge map; native supported inverse codecs are gzip and zstd.

consequence: A malformed or valid xz sidecar cannot make an otherwise ineligible source enter the Logs terminal because the frontdoor proof ignores xz.
After entry, xz cannot contribute to the final shipping inverse-edge count because canonical V3 filters to gzip/zstd.
Therefore rank-safe xz pre-decode pruning removes only speculative relation-discovery work/failure exposure; xz bytes remain ordinary authenticated direct user data.

The optimization can still change product behavior on a source that already has >=2 gzip/zstd structural witnesses plus malformed xz: current code may abort/fallback during irrelevant xz decoding, while the candidate can continue to exact gzip/zstd admission. That intended robustness change must remain covered by exact same-input product tests.
non_claims: This does not authorize skipping malformed supported gzip/zstd discovery.
This does not grant archive-byte identity without the exact-head product A/B.
This does not change release admission thresholds or codec support.
claim_boundary: Source-structure/admission derivation only; no product or release credit.
